brand.name: CalculateMyTax
brand.urlNote: The live address, used for canonical links, the sitemap, robots.txt, llms.txt, structured data and social images. It is the GitHub Pages address until calculatemytax.uk is registered; then change it to "https://calculatemytax.uk", set customDomain and basePath as described below, and rebuild.
brand.description: Free UK tax calculators and plain-English guides for landlords, built on current HMRC rates.
brand.logoNote: logoSource is the original logo upload. It is not published; build/asset-studio.html crops it into the header logo (without the tagline, which is too small to read at header size), the full footer logo, the favicons and the social image.

customDomainNote: Leave empty until calculatemytax.uk is registered and its DNS points at GitHub Pages. When filled in, the build writes docs/CNAME so GitHub keeps the custom domain.
basePathNote: Used only by 404.html, which GitHub Pages serves at any missing address. It is "/CalculateMyTax/" while the site runs at muhammadaliseo.github.io/CalculateMyTax/. Change it back to "/" once calculatemytax.uk points at the site.

header.note: The header menu is Home, Calculators, Guides, Our services and Contact, then the call-to-action button. Who we can help is listed in the footer only.

contact.formNote: The contact form is delivered by FormSubmit (formsubmit.co) to hivenexis6@gmail.com. The first message sends an activation email to that inbox. After activating, replace the email address in formAction and formAjax with the random string FormSubmit provides, so the Gmail address is not visible in the page source. See handover/EMAIL-SETUP.md.

tools.name: Rental income tax calculator
tools.summary: Work out the tax on your rental profit, including Section 24 mortgage interest relief.
capabilities: Estimates UK income tax on rental profit for every tax year in the rates file
Covers England, Wales and Northern Ireland, and Scotland
Applies the Section 24 mortgage interest credit with all three limits and carry-forward
Compares allowable expenses, the property allowance and Rent a Room relief, and recommends the cheapest
Handles joint ownership at any split, using each owner's other income
Pools several properties into one property business
Uses brought-forward property losses and unrelieved finance costs
Flags Making Tax Digital thresholds and the April 2027 property income rates
Runs in the browser with no sign-up; results can be shared as a link or printed

tools.name: Rental yield calculator
tools.summary: Work out gross and net rental yield, cash flow and return on cash, after mortgage costs and income tax.
capabilities: Works out gross and net rental yield from the price, rent, running costs and empty weeks
Itemises running costs, with the letting agent fee as a percentage of the rent collected
Models the first year of an interest-only or repayment mortgage, with interest cover
Shows monthly and annual cash flow and the return on the cash you put in, including buying costs
Estimates income tax on the rental profit with Section 24, for England, Wales, Northern Ireland and Scotland
Runs in the browser with no sign-up; results can be shared as a link or printed
